name: Mnemoverse
tagline: Memory you can rate and share
description: Mnemoverse is hosted long-term memory for AI agents. An agent saves a preference or a decision and finds it later with a plain question. The same account works in ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and VS Code. Rating a recalled memory as helpful or misleading re-ranks what comes back next. Shared rooms let several people's assistants read and write one memory. Mnemoverse receives what an agent saves and the questions it searches with.

prompts.text: Before we start, check Mnemoverse for what I decided about this project last time.
Save each decision from this chat to Mnemoverse as a separate memory.
In Mnemoverse, rate the memories you used in this chat: which helped and which were wrong.

apps.name: Mnemoverse
apps.description: Save, search and rate memories in your Mnemoverse account.
